mapper.sql: EVAL_MODEL_ID, MODEL_CODE, MODEL_NAME, DATA_MODEL_ID, BUSINESS_SCENARIO, INDUSTRY_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, SCORE_ALGORITHM, TOTAL_WEIGHT, RISK_THRESHOLD_LOW, RISK_THRESHOLD_MEDIUM, RISK_THRESHOLD_HIGH, VERSION, STATUS, IS_ENABLED, ACCURACY_RATE, WARNING_COUNT, LAST_TEST_TIME, PUBLISH_TIME, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, PARAMETER_CONFIG, REMARK, SCHEDULE_CONFIG
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draftCount, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'TESTING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as testingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as publishedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ARCHIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as archivedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_ENABLED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_ENABLED = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as disabledCount FROM TBL_EVALUATION_MODEL

SELECT BUSINESS_SCENARIO as scenario, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_EVALUATION_MODEL), 2) as percentage FROM TBL_EVALUATION_MODEL GROUP BY BUSINESS_SCENARIO ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
FROM TBL_EVALUATION_MODEL WHERE UPDATE_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY UPDATE_TIME DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
FROM TBL_EVALUATION_MODEL WHERE ACCURACY_RATE IS NOT NULL AND STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY ACCURACY_RATE DESC LIMIT #{limit}
